title: getLoanAccountOverviewDetails — DPI amount fields in response

assertions.name: dpi_overdue_matches_db
assertions.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ldd.due_date < CURRENT_DATE OR ldd.overdue_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN ldd.due_amount - ldd.paid_amount - ldd.waived_amount ELSE 0 END), 0)::text FROM mfi_accounting.loan_due_details ldd JOIN mfi_accounting.loan_account la ON la.account_id = ldd.loan_account_id JOIN mfi_accounting.account a ON a.id = la.account_id WHERE a.account_number = ':ACCOUNT_NUMBER' AND ldd.component_type = 'DPI' AND ldd.is_deleted = false AND la.is_deleted = false
